correctness.rationale: The nested falsity sets B_0=empty, B_{j+1}={x: exists y in R[x], R[y] subset B_j} reproduce falsity of (Box Diamond)^(j+1) top. The rank-core minimal-finite-rank contradiction forces every finite-rank point to have an infinite-rank successor. Starting with a stage-(m+1) new failure, alternating x_j (ranks j) and y_{j-1} (infinite rank, with R[y] subset B_{j-1} but not B_{j-2}) gives 2(m+1) different points. The 2m+2-vertex directed path has initial distance 2m+1 to terminal and first failure at m+1. All nonempty arbitrary frames allowed. Independent direct recurrence checks cover all labelled relations n<=3 and 4096 n=4; finite enumeration cannot replace the rank proof.
